contract.assumptions: Complete same-principal family proof, without independent review or priority clearance. General weak-reversibility recurrence remains open. Stationary exponential count/activity rewards and all polynomial physical returns coexist with NO positive exponential physical return moment. No practical crossover; chemistry non-operational.
contract.costs:
Acquired rational chart/profile constants, finite integer head, explicit deletion paths and exact factored reward bounds; Voff is proved bounded,not numerically evaluated. Huge powers/head are not expanded/enumerated.
k4 rates(1,1,1,1,2) head about2.86e45; no useful tail/mixing computation or practical crossover. Ordinary product-Poisson reward is much sharper on the complex-balanced locus.

contract.provides: The author-derived construction closes all faces for y0=0,y1=(1,1,0),yj=(j,j-1,j-1),2<=j<=k, in the cycle y0->...->yk->0, every k>=3 and fixed positive rates. It proves nonexplosion, irreducible positive recurrence and stationary exponential inventory/activity rewards through one shared physical return contract.
contract.requires:
Three free count inventories, ordinary integer falling-factorial propensities kappa_i(x)_yi with all fixed kappa_i>0; exact ordered grammar and no hidden factorial divisors.
The theorem covers real positive rates; certificate acquisition uses positive rational rates and rational1<u<t. Unsupported lists return UNKNOWN. Old N1567 sufficient terminal-gap family remains distinct.
